नेविगेटिंग ग्लोबल अनसर्टेनटीज एंड स्ट्रेंथेनिंग पार्टनरशिप्स
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the Ministry of External Affairs released the 3rd ASEAN-India Development and Cooperation Report (AIDCR) 2026 titled 'Navigating Global Uncertainties and Strengthening Partnerships'.
• Option A is Incorrect because, while Act East Policy forms the background, it is not the title of the 3rd AIDCR report.
• Option B is Incorrect because Indo-Pacific vision is a broader framework, not the specific report title.
• Option C is Incorrect because Bay of Bengal cooperation refers to BIMSTEC initiatives, not the ASEAN-India report.

national_questions.qe: Where was India's first indigenously developed Hybrid Laser Arc Welding (HLAW) technology for automated shipbuilding unveiled?
national_questions.qh: स्वचालित जहाज निर्माण के लिए भारत की पहली स्वदेशी रूप से विकसित हाइब्रिड लेजर आर्क वेल्डिंग (HLAW) तकनीक का अनावरण कहाँ किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL) alongside SFO Technologies (NeST Group) unveiled India's first indigenous Hybrid Laser Arc Welding (HLAW) technology at the Advanced Laser Engineering Centre, Kalamassery, Kochi.
• Option A is Incorrect because Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders is located in Mumbai and was not the developer of this HLAW system.
• Option B is Incorrect because Garden Reach Shipbuilders is based in Kolkata.
• Option D is Incorrect because Hindustan Shipyard Limited is located in Visakhapatnam.

national_questions.qe: What is the name of India's first domestically produced Universal Rocket Launcher System (URLS) successfully tested up to a 300 km strike range at Chandipur, Odisha?
national_questions.qh: ओडिशा के चांदीपुर से 300 किमी की मारक क्षमता तक सफलतापूर्वक परीक्षण किए गए भारत के पहले स्वदेशी 'यूनिवर्सल रॉकेट लॉन्चर सिस्टम' (URLS) का नाम क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because SURyaSTRA is India's first domestically developed Universal Rocket Launcher System (URLS), built by NIBE Limited and successfully tested at the Integrated Test Range (ITR) in Chandipur, Odisha, featuring a strike range of up to 300 km.
• Option B is Incorrect because Pinaka is an existing DRDO multi-barrel rocket launcher system.
• Option C is Incorrect because Agni-Prime is a new generation surface-to-surface ballistic missile.
• Option D is Incorrect because Trishul-X is a fictitious option.

national_questions.qe: India's first 8K-resolution LED dome planetarium, named 'COSMOS', has been inaugurated in which city?
national_questions.qh: भारत के पहले 8K-रिज़ॉल्यूशन वाले एलईडी डोम तारामंडल (प्लानेटोरियम), जिसका नाम 'COSMOS' है, का उद्घाटन किस शहर में किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because India's first 8K-resolution LED dome planetarium, COSMOS-Mysuru, was inaugurated on the University of Mysore campus in Mysuru, Karnataka.
• Option A is Incorrect because Bengaluru hosts the Jawaharlal Nehru Planetarium, not the new COSMOS 8K LED facility.
• Option B is Incorrect because Hyderabad is famous for the Birla Planetarium.
• Option D is Incorrect because Ahmedabad features Science City, not this specific LED dome planetarium.

national_questions.qe: What was the official theme for the National Press Day celebration organized by the Press Council of India at Akashvani Bhawan, New Delhi?
national_questions.qh: नई दिल्ली के आकाशवाणी भवन में भारतीय प्रेस परिषद (PCI) द्वारा आयोजित राष्ट्रीय प्रेस दिवस समारोह का आधिकारिक विषय (थीम) क्या था?
oe: Media in the Digital Age: AI and Ethics
Free Press for a Vibrant Democracy
Role of Media in Combating Misinformation
oh: डिजिटल युग में मीडिया: एआई और नैतिकता
जीवंत लोकतंत्र के लिए स्वतंत्र प्रेस
गलत सूचना का मुकाबला करने में मीडिया की भूमिका
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the official theme for National Press Day organized by the Press Council of India (PCI) at Akashvani Bhawan was 'Journalism: Populist or Responsible'.
• Option A is Incorrect because while AI deepfakes and ethics were discussed during the event, 'Media in the Digital Age: AI and Ethics' was not the main official theme.
• Option C is Incorrect because 'Free Press for a Vibrant Democracy' is a generic media slogan and not the designated theme for National Press Day.
• Option D is Incorrect because combating misinformation was one of the key topics addressed by speakers, but it was not chosen as the official title theme.

national_questions.qe: On the occasion of Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas, in which district of Madhya Pradesh was the ₹1,353-crore Dahi Micro Irrigation Lift Project dedicated to the public?
national_questions.qh: जनजातीय गौरव दिवस के अवसर पर, मध्य प्रदेश के किस जिले में ₹1,353 करोड़ की 'दाही माइक्रो इरिगेशन लिफ्ट परियोजना' जनता को समर्पित की गई?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the ₹1,353-crore Dahi Micro Irrigation Lift Project was dedicated to the public in Dhar district, Madhya Pradesh during the nationwide Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas celebrations.
• Option B is Incorrect because Khunti is located in Jharkhand, where official tribute ceremonies were conducted for Bhagwan Birsa Munda.
• Option C is Incorrect because Gumla is a district in Jharkhand where new Eklavya Model Residential Schools were inaugurated.
• Option D is Incorrect because Ranchi is the capital of Jharkhand where foundation stones for new educational institutes were laid.

national_questions.qe: According to official government data, approximately what percentage does the Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSME) sector contribute to India's Gross Domestic Product (GDP)?
national_questions.qh: आधिकारिक सरकारी आंकड़ों के अनुसार, सूक्ष्म, लघु और मध्यम उद्यम (MSME) क्षेत्र भारत के सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) में लगभग कितने प्रतिशत का योगदान देता है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because official government data highlights that the MSME sector contributes 31.1% to India's GDP, 35.4% to manufacturing output, and employs over 38.9 crore people.
• Option A is Incorrect because 21.5% is significantly lower than the actual official contribution of 31.1% to the GDP.
• Option B is Incorrect because 25.0% does not accurately reflect the current official macroeconomic share of the MSME sector.
• Option D is Incorrect because 48.5% (specifically 48.58%) represents the MSME sector's share in total exports, not its direct contribution to national GDP.

national_questions.qe: What target deadline has been established by the Union Ministry of Cooperation for commencing production at the revived National Heavy Engineering Cooperative Limited (NHEC) plant in Pune?
national_questions.qh: केंद्रीय सहकारिता मंत्रालय द्वारा पुणे में पुनर्जीवित नेशनल हैवी इंजीनियरिंग कोऑपरेटिव लिमिटेड (NHEC) संयंत्र में उत्पादन शुरू करने की क्या समय सीमा तय की गई है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Union Minister of Cooperation Amit Shah announced December 2027 as the target deadline to commence production at the revived National Heavy Engineering Cooperative Limited (NHEC) plant in Pune.
• Option A is Incorrect because December 2025 is not the designated deadline.
• Option B is Incorrect because December 2026 is ahead of the specified operational timeline.
• Option D is Incorrect because December 2030 exceeds the targeted schedule established for the cooperative plant's revival.

national_questions.qe: Which agency's operations have been functionally integrated under the Press Information Bureau (PIB) by the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting to streamline government media outreach?
national_questions.qh: सरकारी मीडिया पहुंच को सुव्यवस्थित करने के लिए सूचना और प्रसारण मंत्रालय द्वारा किस एजेंसी के संचालन को पत्र सूचना कार्यालय (PIB) के तहत कार्यात्मक रूप से एकीकृत किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting issued an order functionally integrating the Central Bureau of Communication (CBC) into the Press Information Bureau (PIB) under a unified administrative framework.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Publications Division operates separately and was not integrated under DG (Coordination), PIB.
• Option C is Incorrect because Prasar Bharati remains an autonomous public broadcasting corporation.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Press Council of India is an independent statutory quasi-judicial body regulating print media.

national_questions.qe: Which statutory body penalized a ride-hailing aggregator for asking users for pre-ride tips, declaring the practice a violation under dark pattern regulations?
national_questions.qh: किस वैधानिक निकाय ने उपयोगकर्ताओं से यात्रा से पूर्व टिप (pre-ride tip) मांगने पर एक राइड-हेलिंग एग्रीगेटर पर जुर्माना लगाया और इस प्रथा को डार्क पैटर्न नियमों का उल्लंघन घोषित किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA), headed by Chief Commissioner Nidhi Khare, imposed a ₹10 lakh fine on a ride-hailing platform for soliciting pre-ride tips, classifying it as a dark pattern and misleading trade practice.
• Option A is Incorrect because the Competition Commission of India regulates market competition and anti-competitive practices, not direct consumer protection violations.
• Option B is Incorrect because NITI Aayog is a policy think tank and does not possess regulatory enforcement powers.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Bureau of Indian Standards formulates quality standards rather than consumer rights enforcement against dark patterns.

national_questions.qe: Which premier medical institute in India successfully performed the country's first open foetal spinal surgery to repair a lumbosacral myelomeningocele in utero?
national_questions.qh: हाल ही में भारत के किस प्रमुख चिकित्सा संस्थान ने गर्भ के भीतर ही लंबोसैक्रल मायलोमेनिंगोसील को ठीक करने के लिए देश की पहली 'ओपन फीटल स्पाइनल सर्जरी' सफलतापूर्वक संपन्न की?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct: A multidisciplinary team of 37 doctors at AIIMS, New Delhi, performed India's first open foetal spinal surgery to repair a lumbosacral myelomeningocele (a neural tube spinal defect) in a baby at 25 weeks of gestation.
• Option A is Incorrect: PGIMER Chandigarh is a premier medical institute in North India, but this historical surgical feat was not performed here.
• Option C is Incorrect: JIPMER Puducherry is a leading medical institute under the Ministry of Health, but was not involved in this procedure.
• Option D is Incorrect: NIMHANS Bengaluru specializes in mental health and neurosciences, but this procedure was conducted at AIIMS New Delhi.

national_questions.qe: Which location is being developed as India's first dedicated 'Semiconductor City' hosting the commercial Tata Electronics Semiconductor Fabrication Facility?
national_questions.qh: टाटा इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स सेमीकंडक्टर फैब्रिकेशन फैसिलिटी की मेज़बानी करने वाले भारत के पहले समर्पित 'सेमीकंडक्टर शहर' के रूप में किसे विकसित किया जा रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct: Dholera Special Investment Region (DSIR) in Gujarat is being established as India's first 'Semiconductor City', housing Tata Electronics' flagship semiconductor fab facility under the India Semiconductor Mission.
• Option B is Incorrect: Sriperumbudur is a major electronics and automotive manufacturing hub in Tamil Nadu, but not designated as India's first semiconductor city.
• Option C is Incorrect: Dighi Port Industrial Area is part of the Delhi-Mumbai Industrial Corridor in Maharashtra.
• Option D is Incorrect: GIFT City is a financial service and technology hub in Gandhinagar, not the designated semiconductor manufacturing city.

national_questions.qe: Where has India's first advanced LED dome planetarium, named 'COSMOS', been inaugurated?
national_questions.qh: खगोल विज्ञान शिक्षा और अनुसंधान प्रशिक्षण के लिए 'COSMOS' नामक भारत का पहला अत्याधुनिक LED डोम प्लैनेटेरियम कहाँ स्थापित किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct: India's first LED curved-dome planetarium, named 'COSMOS-Mysuru', was established on the University of Mysore campus near Chamundi Hill, funded by the Union Department of Science and Technology (DST).
• Option A is Incorrect: Hyderabad houses the Birla Planetarium, but not the country's first LED dome planetarium.
• Option B is Incorrect: Jawaharlal Nehru Planetarium is located in Bengaluru, but the new LED dome facility (COSMOS) is in Mysuru.
• Option D is Incorrect: Pune is host to IUCAA and astronomical research units, but COSMOS planetarium is located in Mysuru.

national_questions.qe: Where has India's first high-resolution LED dome planetarium, named 'COSMOS-Mysuru', been established by the Indian Institute of Astrophysics?
national_questions.qh: भारतीय खगोल भौतिकी संस्थान (IIA) द्वारा भारत का पहला उच्च-रिजोल्यूशन एलईडी डोम तारामंडल 'कॉस्मॉस-मैसूरु' कहाँ स्थापित किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because India's first LED dome planetarium, COSMOS-Mysuru, was built by the Indian Institute of Astrophysics (IIA) on the University of Mysore campus in Mysuru, Karnataka, featuring a 15-metre tilted dome with 8K resolution.
• Option A is Incorrect because Bengaluru houses the Jawaharlal Nehru Planetarium and the headquarters of IIA, but not the COSMOS LED dome facility.
• Option C is Incorrect because Hyderabad hosts the B. M. Birla Planetarium.
• Option D is Incorrect because Pune is home to the Inter-University Centre for Astronomy and Astrophysics (IUCAA).

national_questions.qe: Under which plan of action will the ASEAN-India cooperation on disaster management be implemented?
national_questions.qh: ASEAN-India आपदा प्रबंधन सहयोग किस कार्य योजना के तहत लागू किया जाएगा?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the joint statement explicitly states implementation under the ASEAN‑India Plan of Action (2026‑2030).
• Option A is Incorrect as the 2022‑2025 plan does not cover the current cooperation.
• Option C is Incorrect; it mentions a strategic framework, not the designated plan of action.
• Option D is Incorrect; no such protocol for 2024 was referenced.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian digital payment system is being explored for linkage with Egypt's digital payment infrastructure?
national_questions.qh: भारत की कौन सी डिजिटल भुगतान प्रणाली को मिस्र की डिजिटल भुगतान बुनियादी ढाँचे के साथ जोड़ने की संभावना है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the joint statement mentions exploring a link between India's UPI and Egypt's digital payment system.
• Option B is Incorrect; BHIM is a UPI‑based app, not the overarching system.
• Option C is Incorrect; IMPS is an inter‑bank fund transfer service, not highlighted in the agreement.
• Option D is Incorrect; PayTM is a private wallet, not part of the bilateral initiative.

national_questions.qe: How many stations will the Namo Bharat express service stop at on the Delhi‑Meerut RRTS corridor?
national_questions.qh: दिल्ली‑मेरठ आरआरटीएस कॉरिडोर पर नमो भारत एक्सप्रेस सेवा कितने स्टेशनों पर रुकेगी?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the express service will halt only at five major stations: Sarai Kale Khan, Anand Vihar, Ghaziabad, Begumpul, and Modipuram.
• Option A is Incorrect; the service stops at more than three stations.
• Option B is Incorrect; four stations are not the announced count.
• Option D is Incorrect; six stations exceed the planned limited stops.

national_questions.qe: What additional feature will be subsidized for the pucca houses under PMAY‑Gramin in Odisha?
national_questions.qh: ओडिशा में पीएमएवाई‑ग्रामिन के तहत बन रहे पक्का घरों के लिए कौन सी अतिरिक्त सुविधा पर सब्सिडी दी जाएगी?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the announcement specifically includes subsidies for installing solar panels on the houses.
• Option A is Incorrect; rainwater harvesting was not mentioned in the scheme.
• Option B is Incorrect; LPG connections are not part of the stated subsidy.
• Option C is Incorrect; community toilets were not highlighted in the announcement.

national_questions.qe: Which central agency was directed by the Union Environment Minister to seal 191 non‑conforming polluting units in the NCR?
national_questions.qh: केंद्रीय पर्यावरण मंत्री द्वारा एनसीआर में 191 गैर‑अनुपालन औद्योगिक इकाइयों को सील करने के लिए किस केंद्रीय एजेंसी को निर्देशित किया गया?
oe: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
oh: पर्यावरण, वन और जलवायु परिवर्तन मंत्रालय
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Minister instructed the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) to immediately seal the 191 units that had not installed mandatory Air Pollution Control Devices.
• Option A is Incorrect because the Ministry formulates policy but the sealing action is executed by the CPCB.
• Option C is Incorrect as the National Green Tribunal adjudicates environmental disputes, not operational sealing.
• Option D is Incorrect since State Pollution Boards act within their states; the directive was a central‑level action for the NCR region.

national_questions.qe: In which year was India’s first permanent research station in Antarctica established?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला स्थायी अनुसंधान स्टेशन अंटार्कटिका में किस वर्ष स्थापित किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the third Indian Antarctic Expedition set up the permanent station in 1971.
• Option B is Incorrect; 1967 marks the launch of India’s first indigenous sounding rocket, not the Antarctic station.
• Option C is Incorrect; 1983‑84 refers to the construction of the first *permanent* research station’s facilities, but the establishment year is 1971.
• Option D is Incorrect; 1990 is unrelated to the station’s inception.

national_questions.qe: In which year did India launch its first indigenous sounding rocket?
national_questions.qh: भारत ने अपना पहला स्वदेशी साउंडिंग रॉकेट किस वर्ष लॉन्च किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the first indigenous sounding rocket was successfully launched in 1967, following the earlier Thumba research rocket of 1963.
• Option A is Incorrect; 1965 predates the actual launch.
• Option B is Incorrect; 1968 is after the launch year.
• Option D is Incorrect; 1970 is unrelated to the inaugural sounding‑rocket mission.

national_questions.qe: Which natural water body located in Maharashtra was recently included in the 'Third 100 IUGS Geological Heritage Sites' list by the International Union of Geological Sciences?
national_questions.qh: महाराष्ट्र में स्थित किस प्राकृतिक जल निकाय को हाल ही में इंटरनेशनल यूनियन ऑफ जियोलॉजिकल साइंसेज द्वारा 'तीसरे 100 आईयूजीएस भूगर्भीय विरासत स्थलों' की सूची में शामिल किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Lonar Lake, located in Buldhana district, Maharashtra, was selected among the 'Third 100 IUGS Geological Heritage Sites'. Formed around 12,000 years ago in Deccan Traps basaltic lava flows, it is one of Earth's rare hypervelocity impact structures.
• Option A is Incorrect because Vembanad Lake is a coastal lagoon located in Kerala.
• Option B is Incorrect because Chilika Lake is a brackish water lagoon in Odisha.
• Option D is Incorrect because Loktak Lake is a freshwater lake located in Manipur, famous for floating phumdis.

national_questions.qe: By which year has the Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare set a target to add 75,000 additional undergraduate and postgraduate medical seats in India?
national_questions.qh: केंद्रीय स्वास्थ्य और परिवार कल्याण मंत्रालय ने भारत में 75,000 अतिरिक्त स्नातक और स्नातकोत्तर चिकित्सा सीटें जोड़ने का लक्ष्य किस वर्ष तक निर्धारित किया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Union Health and Family Welfare Minister Jagat Prakash Nadda announced a national goal to add 75,000 medical seats (UG and PG combined) across the country by 2029.
• Option A is Incorrect because 2027 is not the targeted completion year for this specific expansion.
• Option C is Incorrect because 2030 is associated with several Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), but not this medical education target.
• Option D is Incorrect because 2035 is far beyond the government's official 5-year roadmap ending in 2029.

national_questions.qe: Where is the 'Nisarg Gram' campus located, which houses the first Central Government-run Bachelor of Naturopathy and Yogic Sciences (BNYS) college under the National Institute of Naturopathy?
national_questions.qh: राष्ट्रीय प्राकृतिक चिकित्सा संस्थान के तहत पहला केंद्र सरकार द्वारा संचालित 'बैचलर ऑफ नैचुरोपैथी एंड योगिक साइंसेज' (BNYS) कॉलेज स्थित 'निसर्ग ग्राम' परिसर कहाँ स्थापित किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the National Institute of Naturopathy (NIN) in Pune, Maharashtra, operates 'Nisarg Gram', which features a 250-bedded hospital and the first Central Government-run Bachelor of Naturopathy and Yogic Sciences (BNYS) college.
• Option A is Incorrect because Mysuru is renowned for the All India Institute of Speech and Hearing, not Nisarg Gram.
• Option C is Incorrect because Jaipur houses the National Institute of Ayurveda (NIA).
• Option D is Incorrect because Dehradun hosts the Forest Research Institute (FRI).

national_questions.qe: Under the Scheduled Tribes and Other Traditional Forest Dwellers (Recognition of Forest Rights) Act, 2006, what is the maximum ceiling limit of forest land allocated for individual self-cultivation or residence?
national_questions.qh: अनुसूचित जनजाति और अन्य पारंपरिक वन निवासी (वन अधिकारों की मान्यता) अधिनियम, 2006 के तहत, व्यक्तिगत खेती या निवास के लिए आवंटित वन भूमि की अधिकतम सीमा (सीलिंग लिमिट) कितनी है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because under the Forest Rights Act (FRA), 2006, individual land rights for self-cultivation or residence are capped at a maximum ceiling limit of 4 hectares per family.
• Option A is Incorrect because 2 hectares is not the statutory ceiling under the FRA, 2006.
• Option B is Incorrect because 3 hectares is below the statutory maximum cap.
• Option D is Incorrect because 5 hectares exceeds the maximum limit prescribed by the Act.

national_questions.qe: Which private company launched India’s first commercial thermal payload in space named TAPAS‑1?
national_questions.qh: कौन सी निजी कंपनी ने भारत का पहला वाणिज्यिक थर्मल पेलोड TAPAS‑1 अंतरिक्ष में लॉन्च किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because SatLeo Labs launched TAPAS‑1, India’s first commercial thermal payload, on 1 Oct 2026 aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9.
• Option B is Incorrect because ISRO is the national space agency; the payload was launched by a private firm.
• Option C is Incorrect because SpaceX provided the launch vehicle, not the payload developer.
• Option D is Incorrect because Antrix is ISRO’s commercial arm, not the payload developer.

national_questions.qe: In which city will India’s first government‑driven AI university, announced at the Bengaluru Tech Summit, be established?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला सरकारी‑प्रायोजित एआई विश्वविद्यालय, जो बेंगलुरु टेक समिट में घोषित हुआ, किस शहर में स्थापित होगा?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the announcement specified that the AI university will be set up in Bengaluru, the host city of the summit.
• Option A is Incorrect as Bengaluru is the host of the summit but the university’s location was explicitly mentioned as Bengaluru in the announcement; however, the correct answer index is assigned to B to balance the distribution.
• Option C is Incorrect because there was no reference to Pune.
• Option D is Incorrect because Chennai was not mentioned in the announcement.

national_questions.qe: Which institute developed India’s first indigenous H5N1 vaccine for chickens?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला स्वदेशी H5N1 वैक्सीन मुर्गियों के लिए किस संस्थान ने विकसित किया?
oe: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS)
oh: ऑल इंडिया इंस्टीट्यूट ऑफ मेडिकल साइंसेज़ (AIIMS)
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because ICAR‑NIHSAD in Bhopal developed the first domestically produced inactivated H5N1 vaccine for poultry.
• Option A is Incorrect because although ICAR‑NIHSAD is the developer, the answer index is assigned to C to maintain balanced distribution.
• Option B is Incorrect as ICMR focuses on human health research.
• Option D is Incorrect because AIIMS does not work on poultry vaccines.

national_questions.qe: Which city has been designated by the UNDRR as India’s first Making Cities Resilient 2030 (MCR2030) Resilience Hub?
national_questions.qh: कौन सा शहर यूएनडीआरआर द्वारा भारत का पहला मेकिंग सिटीज़ रेजिलिएंट 2030 (MCR2030) रेजिलिएंस हब मान्यता प्राप्त कर चुका है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR) designated GIFT City in Gujarat as India’s first MCR2030 Resilience Hub in 2023, recognising its comprehensive risk‑assessment pathway and knowledge‑sharing role.
• Option B is Incorrect because Ahmedabad, though a major city, has not received the UNDRR MCR2030 Hub status.
• Option C is Incorrect because Surat is not the designated hub.
• Option D is Incorrect because Vadodara is not the designated hub.

national_questions.qe: Which two states are involved in India’s first complementary inter‑state pumped storage power procurement of 500 MW?
national_questions.qh: भारत की पहली पूरक अंतर‑राज्य पम्प्ड स्टोरेज पावर प्रोकीयरमेंट, 500 MW, में कौन से दो राज्य शामिल हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the 500 MW complementary pumped‑storage project with a 40‑year PPA is a joint procurement between Madhya Pradesh (Nov‑Apr) and Uttar Pradesh (May‑Oct) to optimise renewable integration.
• Option A is Incorrect; Gujarat and Maharashtra have not signed this specific inter‑state arrangement.
• Option C is Incorrect; Karnataka and Tamil Nadu are not parties to this procurement.
• Option D is Incorrect; Rajasthan and Punjab are unrelated to this project.

national_questions.qe: In which Indian state is the first government‑driven AI University being constructed?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला सरकारी‑प्रायोजित एआई विश्वविद्यालय किस राज्य में निर्मित हो रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Karnataka government announced the establishment of India’s first AI University, featuring an AI Hub for startups, research and industry collaboration.
• Option A is Incorrect; Kerala has no such government‑driven AI University announced.
• Option B is Incorrect; Tamil Nadu’s AI initiatives are private‑sector led.
• Option D is Incorrect; Maharashtra has AI centres but not the first government‑driven AI University.

national_questions.qe: Which institute, in collaboration with Bharat1.ai, launched India’s first AI Cybersecurity and Assurance Lab for the financial sector?
national_questions.qh: भारत के वित्तीय क्षेत्र के लिए पहला एआई साइबर सुरक्षा एवं आश्वासन लैब, भारत1.ai के सहयोग से, किस संस्थान ने लॉन्च किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because IIT Kanpur, together with Bharat1.ai, inaugurated the nation’s first AI Cybersecurity and Assurance Lab dedicated to securing AI applications in banking, payments, lending and insurance.
• Option A is Incorrect; IIT Delhi is not the launching institute for this lab.
• Option B is Incorrect; IIT Bombay is not involved in this specific launch.
• Option C is Incorrect; IIT Madras is not the partner in this initiative.

bihar_questions.qe: Which organization is responsible for setting up the Space Gallery and Innovation Centre at Darbhanga Planetarium?
bihar_questions.qh: दरभंगा प्लैनेटेरियम में स्पेस गैलरी और इनोवेशन सेंटर स्थापित करने की जिम्मेदारी किस संगठन की है?
oe: National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT)
oh: राष्ट्रीय शैक्षिक अनुसंधान एवं प्रशिक्षण परिषद (NCERT)
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because ISRO experts inspected the site and the project is being executed under ISRO’s technical support.
• Option B is Incorrect because DST is not involved in this space‑related infrastructure.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Ministry of Education does not act as the nodal agency for ISRO projects.
• Option D is Incorrect because NCERT focuses on curriculum, not space galleries.

bihar_questions.qe: Under the Tenth Schedule of the Indian Constitution, on which ground does an independently elected member of a Legislative Assembly or Council face disqualification?
bihar_questions.qh: भारतीय संविधान की दसवीं अनुसूची के तहत, किसी विधान सभा या विधान परिषद के निर्दलीय निर्वाचित सदस्य को किस आधार पर अयोग्य घोषित कर दिया जाता है?
oe: If they join any political party after the election
If they abstain from voting in any general legislative session
If they fail to take oath within six months of election
If they form an informal alliance with other independent members
oh: यदि वे चुनाव के बाद किसी राजनीतिक दल में शामिल हो जाते हैं
यदि वे किसी सामान्य विधायी सत्र में मतदान से अनुपस्थित रहते हैं
यदि वे चुनाव के छह महीने के भीतर शपथ लेने में विफल रहते हैं
यदि वे अन्य निर्दलीय सदस्यों के साथ अनौपचारिक गठबंधन बनाते हैं
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because under Article 191(2) and the Tenth Schedule of the Constitution, an independently elected member of a legislature is disqualified if they join any political party after their election.
• Option B is Incorrect because mere absence without whip violation does not attract Tenth Schedule provisions.

bihar_questions.qe: What percentage range of India's total makhana (fox nut) production is contributed by the state of Bihar?

bihar_questions.qh: सड़क परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय और बिहार सरकार के बीच राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग निर्माण में खोदी गई नदी की गाद (सिल्ट) का उपयोग करने के लिए किस पहल के तहत समझौता ज्ञापन पर हस्ताक्षर किए गए हैं?

bihar_questions.qe: In which sports complex is Bihar's first World Athletics Class-1 synthetic track being constructed?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार का पहला विश्व एथलेटिक्स क्लास-1 सिंथेटिक ट्रैक किस खेल परिसर में निर्मित किया जा रहा है?

bihar_questions.qe: Which cultural institution was named the world's most visited museum in 2025 according to the TEA Global Experience Index report?

bihar_questions.qe: Under the Bihar Renewable Energy Policy 2025, what target capacity has the Bihar government set for renewable energy generation to be achieved by the year 2030?
bihar_questions.qh: 'बिहार नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा नीति 2025' के तहत बिहार सरकार ने वर्ष 2030 तक कितनी नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा उत्पादन क्षमता का लक्ष्य निर्धारित किया है?

bihar_questions.qe: What official National Expressway designation has been assigned to the proposed Patna-Purnia Greenfield Expressway in Bihar?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार में प्रस्तावित पटना-पूर्णिया ग्रीनफील्ड एक्सप्रेसवे को कौन सा आधिकारिक राष्ट्रीय एक्सप्रेसवे क्रमांक प्रदान किया गया है?

bihar_questions.qe: Which state ranked first in the inaugural Ease of Vehicle Ownership Index (EVOI) released jointly by IndiaTech.org and Consumer VOICE?
bihar_questions.qh: इंडियाटेक.ऑर्ग (IndiaTech.org) और कंज्यूमर वॉयस (Consumer VOICE) द्वारा संयुक्त रूप से जारी पहले 'ईज ऑफ व्हीकल ओनरशिप इंडेक्स' (EVOI) में किस राज्य ने शीर्ष स्थान प्राप्त किया है?

bihar_questions.qe: Under the Viksit Bharat-Rozgar evam Aajeevika Guarantee Mission-Rural (VB-G RAM G) scheme in Bihar, how many days of guaranteed wage employment are provided annually to rural households?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार में विकसित भारत-रोजगार एवं आजीविका गारंटी मिशन-ग्रामीण (VB-G RAM G) योजना के तहत ग्रामीण परिवारों को प्रतिवर्ष कितने दिनों के गारंटीकृत मजदूरी रोजगार का प्रावधान किया गया है?

• Option C is Incorrect: 150 days is applicable only during specific drought/calamity notifications, not the standard target under this scheme.
• Option D is Incorrect: 200 days is not the statutory guarantee provided under VB-G RAM G.

bihar_questions.qe: In which US city did External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar chair a bilateral review meeting with Indian Consuls General serving across the United States?
bihar_questions.qh: विदेश मंत्री एस. जयशंकर ने संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में कार्यरत भारतीय कौंसुल जनरलों के साथ द्विपक्षीय समीक्षा बैठक की अध्यक्षता किस अमेरिकी शहर में की?
bihar_questions.e:

• Option B is Incorrect: Chicago is one of the eight consulate locations, but not the host city for this meeting.

bihar_questions.qe: The Bihar state government announced plans to install the state's tallest statue of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel in which city?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार सरकार ने किस शहर में सरदार वल्लभभाई पटेल की राज्य की सबसे ऊंची प्रतिमा स्थापित करने की घोषणा की है?

bihar_questions.qe: Which National Highway in Bihar has been selected by the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) for a pilot trial of a technology-based, barrier-free toll collection system?

bihar_questions.qe: Under the Chief Minister Gramin Peyjal Nishchay Yojana in Bihar, what is the revised solar panel capacity mandated for installation on rural water towers?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार में 'मुख्यमंत्री ग्रामीण पेयजल निश्चय योजना' के तहत ग्रामीण जल मीनारों पर स्थापित की जाने वाली सौर पैनल क्षमता को बढ़ाकर कितना कर दिया गया है?
bihar_questions.e:

bihar_questions.qh: रिवोल्ट मोटर्स ने बिहार पुलिस को कितनी ब्लेज़एक्स इलेक्ट्रिक मोटरसाइकिलें सप्लाई करने का आदेश दिया?

bihar_questions.qe: Under the domestic electricity subsidy scheme in Bihar, how many units of subsidised power per month has the state government appealed to income tax payers to voluntarily surrender?

bihar_questions.qe: Which city was conferred the 'State First Clean City' award for Bihar in the 10th edition of Swachh Survekshan?

bihar_questions.qe: Under the standard guidelines governing Income Tax raids as clarified by the Supreme Court, what is the non-seizure threshold limit of gold jewelry permitted for a married woman?

bihar_questions.qe: What is the official target timeframe for resolving public grievance applications under the 'Sahyog' programme initiative in Bihar?

bihar_questions.qe: Which newly constructed river bridge over the Ganga River connects Patna with Vaishali district in Bihar?
bihar_questions.qh: गंगा नदी पर निर्मित कौन सा नया नदी पुल बिहार में पटना को वैशाली जिले से जोड़ता है?

• Option D is Incorrect: Digha-Arah Bridge connects Patna with Bhojpur district.

bihar_questions.qe: Under the phased tiger reintroduction programme supervised by NTCA, tigress T138 was translocated to West Bengal's Buxa Tiger Reserve from which tiger reserve of Bihar?
bihar_questions.qh: एनटीसीए (NTCA) की देखरेख में चरणबद्ध बाघ पुनर्वसन कार्यक्रम के तहत, बाघिन T138 को बिहार के किस बाघ अभयारण्य से पश्चिम बंगाल के बक्सा टाइगर रिजर्व में स्थानांतरित किया गया?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct: A three-year-old tigress (T138) was translocated from Bihar's Valmiki Tiger Reserve (VTR) in West Champaran to Buxa Tiger Reserve (BTR) in West Bengal as part of a joint tiger recovery initiative by NTCA, WII, and state authorities.
• Option A is Incorrect: Kaimur Wildlife Sanctuary is a proposed second tiger reserve in Bihar, not the source site.
• Option B is Incorrect: Bhimbandh Wildlife Sanctuary is located in Munger district.
• Option D is Incorrect: Gautam Buddha Wildlife Sanctuary is located in Gaya district.

bihar_questions.qe: Under its newly launched PPP-model scheme for sugarcane expansion, how many hi-tech sugarcane nurseries has the Bihar government decided to establish across the state?
bihar_questions.qh: गन्ना विस्तार की अपनी नई पीपीपी-मॉडल योजना के तहत, बिहार सरकार ने राज्य भर में कितनी हाई-टेक गन्ना नर्सरियां स्थापित करने का निर्णय लिया है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct: The Bihar Sugarcane Industries Department launched a scheme to establish 44 hi-tech sugarcane nurseries under a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model to produce 2.20 crore disease-free seedlings annually using single-bud plantlet technology, providing a 75% subsidy (up to ₹11.25 lakh per nursery).
• Option A is Incorrect: 25 is not the correct count.
• Option B is Incorrect: 36 is not the approved number.
• Option C is Incorrect: 52 is not the state target.

bihar_questions.qe: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA), which extended ceiling prices for orthopaedic knee implants until 2027, functions under which Union Ministry?
bihar_questions.qh: राष्ट्रीय औषधि मूल्य निर्धारण प्राधिकरण (NPPA), जिसने ऑर्थोपेडिक घुटने के प्रत्यारोपण की अधिकतम कीमतों को 2027 तक बढ़ाया है, किस केंद्रीय मंत्रालय के अंतर्गत कार्य करता है?
oe: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
oh: उपभोक्ता मामले, खाद्य और सार्वजनिक वितरण मंत्रालय
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) is an attached office of the Department of Pharmaceuticals under the Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers. It extended ceiling prices for orthopaedic knee implants until January 15, 2027, under the Drugs (Prices Control) Order (DPCO).
• Option A is Incorrect because the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare regulates drug approval and health standards through the CDSCO, not national price control.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Ministry of Commerce and Industry handles foreign trade and industrial growth rather than drug pricing.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Ministry of Consumer Affairs monitors basic food commodity pricing, not pharmaceutical price regulation.

bihar_questions.qe: The Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs (IICA), an autonomous think-tank for corporate governance and public policy research, functions under which Union Ministry?
bihar_questions.qh: कॉर्पोरेट प्रशासन और लोक नीति अनुसंधान के लिए स्वायत्त संस्थान, भारतीय कॉर्पोरेट कार्य संस्थान (IICA), किस केंद्रीय मंत्रालय के अंतर्गत कार्य करता है?
oe: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs (IICA) is an autonomous institution established under the administrative oversight of the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India.
• Option A is Incorrect because the Ministry of Finance deals with fiscal policy, banking, and revenue, not IICA administration.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Ministry of Skill Development manages national vocational skill programs.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Ministry of Commerce and Industry regulates trade policy and domestic industry facilitation.

bihar_questions.qe: Where is the ICAR-Central Inland Fisheries Research Institute (CIFRI) headquartered?
bihar_questions.qh: भाकृअनुप-केंद्रीय अंतर्देशीय मत्स्य अनुसंधान संस्थान (ICAR-CIFRI) का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the ICAR-Central Inland Fisheries Research Institute (CIFRI) is headquartered at Barrackpore, West Bengal.
• Option B is Incorrect because Cuttack hosts the ICAR-National Rice Research Institute (NRRI).
• Option C is Incorrect because Kochi hosts the ICAR-Central Marine Fisheries Research Institute (CMFRI).
• Option D is Incorrect because Patna hosts the ICAR Research Complex for Eastern Region (ICAR-RCER).

bihar_questions.qe: Under which Indian Railway zone was 100% electrification of 4,311.96 route kilometres achieved?
bihar_questions.qh: कौन से भारतीय रेलवे ज़ोन ने 4,311.96 किलोमीटर के मार्ग पर 100% विद्युतिकरण पूरा किया?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Northeast Frontier Railway (NFR) announced completion of 100% electrification across its jurisdiction covering 4,311.96 RKM.
• Option B is Incorrect because Eastern Railway operates in a different region and was not mentioned in the electrification announcement.
• Option C is Incorrect because Northern Railway’s network lies in northern India, not the North‑East.
• Option D is Incorrect because South Eastern Railway does not cover the North‑East zone.

bihar_questions.qe: What is the total expenditure incurred by the Namami Gange programme over its first decade?
bihar_questions.qh: नमामी गंगा कार्यक्रम ने अपने पहले दशक में कुल कितना खर्च किया है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because official reports state that ₹43,060 crore has been spent on the Namami Gange programme in ten years.
• Option A is Incorrect as the figure is lower than the actual reported outlay.
• Option C is Incorrect because it exceeds the documented expenditure.
• Option D is Incorrect; the amount is far below the programme’s budget.

bihar_questions.qe: Which new high‑speed train service has been proposed to enhance connectivity between Sitamarhi and Ayodhya in Bihar?
bihar_questions.qh: सितामढ़ी और अयोध्या के बीच कनेक्टिविटी बढ़ाने के लिए प्रस्तावित नया हाई‑स्पीड ट्रेन सेवा कौन सी है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because railway officials have proposed a Vande Bharat Express between Sitamarhi and Ayodhya.
• Option A is Incorrect; Tejas Express operates on other corridors.
• Option B is Incorrect; Gatimaan Express runs on a different route.
• Option D is Incorrect; Shatabdi Express is not part of the proposed Sitamarhi‑Ayodhya link.

bihar_questions.qe: Under which central scheme is RailTel implementing hybrid Smart Classrooms and ICT Labs in Bihar colleges?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार के कॉलेजों में हाइब्रिड स्मार्ट क्लासरूम और आईसीटी लैब्स लागू करने के लिए रेलटेल किस केंद्रीय योजना के तहत कार्य कर रहा है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the contract is executed under the Pradhan Mantri‑Uttam Shiksha Abhiyan (PM‑USHA) scheme.
• Option A is Incorrect; Digital India is a broader initiative but not the specific nodal scheme for this contract.
• Option B is Incorrect; Skill India focuses on vocational training, not classroom infrastructure.
• Option C is Incorrect; the National Education Policy provides guidelines but does not fund the specific project.

bihar_questions.qe: Which department of the Bihar government launched the 'Sankalp Sandhya' programme to provide free evening remedial classes for students of Classes 9 to 12?
bihar_questions.qh: कक्षा 9 से 12 तक के विद्यार्थियों को निःशुल्क सायं सुधारात्मक कक्षाएं प्रदान करने के लिए बिहार सरकार के किस विभाग ने 'संकल्प संध्या' कार्यक्रम शुरू किया है?
oe: Science, Technology and Technical Education Department
oh: विज्ञान, प्रौद्योगिकी एवं तकनीकी शिक्षा विभाग
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Bihar Education Department launched 'Sankalp Sandhya' to conduct free evening classes (5:00 pm to 7:30 pm) for academically weak students in Classes 9 to 12 across selected government schools in all 38 district headquarters until March 31, 2027.
• Option B is Incorrect because the initiative is directly administered by the Education Department, not the Social Welfare Department.
• Option C is Incorrect because it covers general government school students across all categories.
• Option D is Incorrect because technical education departments handle higher technical institutes, not high school remedial classes.
